checkedOccurrences.text: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.
Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.
It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.
From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.
The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,
The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

wikipediaActualReadJa: Tribe of Zebulun記事の「Division of the land」節を実読。ヨシュア記19:10を起点として紹介する一方で、境界を解明する地名のうち確実に位置を同定できるものは限られると述べ、Joshuaの境界描写と他の解釈との緊張も説明する。人物としての族祖Zebulunではなく、ここでは割当地域を記録する。
geographyCheckJa: 境界の現代地理への対応は未確定。聖書名の町の多くが不明とされ、Wikipedia記載の領域説明も単一の確定境界ではない。
